name: template-registry
body: Template registry / schema engine: schema model (fields, types, formats, body rules, sections) populated from project `template.yaml` manifests by the template-library-loader, with each template's kind taken from its directory (slides/ or sections/). Load-time checks (cycles rejected with the chain in the error, composition depth no greater than six heading levels, directory-kind check for section acceptance and field types, cross-kind name uniqueness, reserved names — `notes`, `body`, the `_format` suffix and the reserved context names `deck`/`slide`/`item` — references, and recursive example validation), lookup and description. Owns the central, documented layout function map (v1: exactly `media "path"` → served URL of the file at the resolved library's `media/<path>`; the path is relative to the resolved library's `media/` and stays within it; a theme's files are addressed from its theme directory, by a relative path or the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix, never through `media`). Templates come solely from the resolved library (global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets).
